thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P1003: high error rate detected for /v1/chat.generate via smart-routing. Auto-pager sent to #incidents and on-call.

oncall-aaron: grabbing this. seeing a spike in 502/500s and some schema errors from chat clients. which customers?

cust-success-elena: multiple enterprise customers reported garbled responses and missing message fields. one report from Acme analytics: 'response body not valid JSON' on upload.

sre-lead-jess: looking at routing logs — traffic was pinned to model_id=redwood-instruct-v1@2026-03-12 (pinned by deploy yesterday) but requests are chat API: content-type expects chat-streaming schema. pinned variant lacks chat protocol -> runtime attempts fallback to nearest compatible variant and triggers route bounce across regions. that caused connection resets and 500s.

oncall-aaron: ok that matches - pinned variant is incompatible. any automatic fallback policy we can flip to stop looping?

maya: temp mitigation: disabled 'smart_fallback: allow_cross_type' in routing policy for that customer group. command I ran: 
``` 
POST /policy/patch
{
  "policy_id": "smart-routing-default",
  "changes": [{"op": "replace", "path": "/allow_cross_type", "value": false}]
}
```
That stopped the immediate cross-type reroutes but pinned model still causing errors for chat clients.

sre-lead-jess: good. next step we should unpin that specific pinned_version for the tenant(s) affected or re-pin to a compatible chat variant. Propose: re-pin to redwood-chat-v2@stable for Acme group.

oncall-aaron: I can do a quick unpin and set an emergency override to route to chat fallback. Doing: `redwoodctl routing set-override --group acme --model redwood-chat-v2@stable`

system (ops-bot): Executed override: routing override for group=acme set to redwood-chat-v2@stable by oncall-aaron.

oncall-aaron: monitor logs now... errors dropping. seeing steady success 200s for chat.generate.

incident-bot: NOTE: incident P1003 severity upgraded to SEV2 due to multiple customers impacted and >1% global error rate.

cust-success-elena: I've started drafting customer comms for Acme and BetaCorp: brief explanation and ETA for root cause fix. ETA to fix is 2 hours for full config rollback.

sre-lead-jess: root cause summary for postmortem: 1) deployment pinned an instruct-only model version to a routing policy that handles chat traffic; 2) fallback policy allowed cross-type reroutes which entered a loop across region variants; 3) cascade of incompatible conversions triggered runtime exceptions and 500s.

maya: temporary mitigation list we applied: 
- disabled allow_cross_type on default routing policy
- applied routing override to redirect affected tenant groups to redwood-chat-v2@stable
- adjusted circuit-breaker to fail-fast on type-mismatch instead of attempting regional reroute

oncall-aaron: I also removed the pin for the global default: `redwoodctl model unpin --policy smart-routing-default --version 2026-03-12`

sre-lead-jess: please capture the diff of policy before/after and upload to the incident artifacts. Also capture the original pinning request.

maya: uploading diffs and logs to /incidents/P1003/artifacts. snippet of relevant log: 
``` 
2026-03-15T14:15:23Z router: incoming request tenant=acme api=chat.generate
2026-03-15T14:15:23Z router: pinned_model=redwood-instruct-v1@2026-03-12
2026-03-15T14:15:23Z runtime: model_type_incompatibility: expected=chat got=instruct
2026-03-15T14:15:23Z router: fallback decision -> candidate=redwood-embed-v1 region=eu-west-1
2026-03-15T14:15:23Z runtime: exception: schema_validation_error -> 500
```

oncall-aaron: handoff to daytime team in 30m. @sre-lead-jess, you're the primary for postmortem. I'll include the mitigation steps in the handoff message.

sre-lead-jess: thanks. action items for follow-up: 
- add a validation gate to pin operations to ensure pinned model's type is compatible with policy's expected API (chat/gen/embed).
- add test for 'allow_cross_type' default to be false for newly created policies.
- alerting: create metric for type-mismatch errors and add a pager threshold.

cust-success-elena: sending proactive note to affected customers now: "We observed an issue where a pinned model variant incompatible with chat traffic caused errors; we've routed you to a compatible model and are implementing safeguards."

incident-bot: INCIDENT P1003: mitigated. Monitoring for 60 minutes before closure.

oncall-aaron: closing my on-call thread, leaving follow-up milestones for Jess. thanks all :thumbsup:

sre-lead-jess: will surface draft postmortem in ~24 hours.

ops-bot: Reminder: run canary to validate pinning workflow after fix: `ops run canary pin-validation --groups acme,beta`

maya: ack, scheduling canary now.
